title: Surreal Wagon Journey
description: A bearded man sits in a red Radio Flyer wagon on a dirt path, holding an ornate golden frame, while a smiling woman in a flowing yellow dress and black hat walks beside him. The dramatic sky features floating classical ruins, swirling portals, glowing butterflies, and pink petals drifting through a red and purple sunset landscape.
prompt: A bearded man in a grey t-shirt sits inside a red Radio Flyer wagon on a winding dirt path through a grassy field, holding a decorative golden picture frame. A joyful woman in a bright yellow and white dress with a black sun hat walks beside him. The dramatic sky shows floating ancient Greek and Roman column ruins, glowing spiral portals, white butterflies, and swirling pink petals. Red sunset with purple clouds and lightning in the distance, whimsical surreal fantasy style.
